title: French Onion Soup
leftover_note: Reheats well; add the baguette and cheese topping fresh.
instructions: Mix the flour, onion soup mix, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Set aside. (The family's version omits the sugar.)

In a large pot, melt the butter. Add the onions and caramelize about 25 minutes on low heat, mixing occasionally. Add the flour mixture to the onions and stir to create a roux. Slowly add the water to the roux, stirring. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer 30 to 40 minutes.

Preheat the oven to broil. Ladle the soup into 6 oven-safe bowls. Float a baguette slice on top of each bowl. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of the shredded mozzarella onto each slice. Set the bowls on a cookie sheet and place under the broiler for 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

For the garlic baguette: preheat the oven to 400°F. Slice the baguette on a diagonal about 1-inch thick and place on a cookie sheet lined with baking paper. Brush each slice with melted butter and sprinkle with the minced garlic. Bake 10 minutes.

tips.title: Family note
tips.text: The family does not add sugar to this soup — leave it out.
